items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Went to work with him. See, they wouldn't let me work. Oh, you remember Clarence Jones? Yes. He put me in the union when I was 12 years old.

ctx.x: So why did you run away from home now? Tell us about that.

Went to work with him. See, they wouldn't let me work. Oh, you remember Clarence Jones? Yes. He put me in the union when I was 12 years old. I worked at a theater in Chicago, a panorama theater. There was four of us, violin, cornet, piano, drums. Schoolbird found out about it and made me quit on account of child labor law. Wouldn't let me work, no kidding.
What kind of place were you working at?
